name: process_refund
description: Issue a refund against an order. The order must already be cancelled or returned; refunding a pending, processing, shipped or delivered order is rejected with invalid_state, so an unshipped order has to be cancelled first. Partial refunds can be repeated up to the order total and remaining_refundable reports the balance left.

error_returns.when: No order exists with the given order_id.
method is not original_payment or store_credit, amount is not positive, or amount is more than the balance still refundable.
The order is not cancelled or returned, or has already been refunded in full.
